# API catalog

The public declarations exported by `osu-files` are listed below. This is auto-generated.

## Database results

- [`Beatmaps`](/api/facades/Beatmaps) - Find and edit beatmap snapshots.
- [`Sets`](/api/facades/Sets) - Find beatmap sets and their files.
- [`Scores`](/api/facades/Scores) - Find scores by player, date, or beatmap.
- [`Collections`](/api/facades/Collections) - Find named beatmap collections.
- [`Rulesets`](/api/facades/Rulesets) - Find installed rulesets.
- [`RulesetSettings`](/api/facades/RulesetSettings) - Read settings for each ruleset.
- [`Skins`](/api/facades/Skins) - Find built-in and user skins.
- [`Files`](/api/facades/Files) - Find file records by hash.
- [`Keybindings`](/api/facades/Keybindings) - Find key bindings.
- [`ModPresets`](/api/facades/ModPresets) - Find saved mod presets.
- [`Metadata`](/api/facades/Metadata) - Search embedded beatmap metadata.
